title: Distinguish unlatched admission from rollout memory reserve

contract.intent: Distinguish unlatched admission from rollout memory reserve

Each resident created by RequestAt -> absent OwnerRead -> Applied epoch1 CAS -> RestoreCompleted -> RuntimeStarted generation1 -> Published; exact operation IDs come from effects

Pressure samples are synthetic byte-valued facts, not measured RSS, allocator, cgroup or container enforcement
The immutable source/runtime-manifest pins and exact implementation must pass preflight before any authorized future run

activate a/request1 in this warm band
return to90 and require no b CAS
